# geoip-shell source bundle

Openwalla vendors the upstream geoip-shell 0.8.5 source release for its
country-blocking feature. The source is distributed under GPL-3.0.

- Upstream: https://github.com/friendly-bits/geoip-shell
- Version: 0.8.5
- License: GPL-3.0

`geoip-shell-0.8.5.tar.gz` is the unmodified upstream source tree. Openwalla's
standalone installer extracts it on the router and runs the upstream
noninteractive source installer with the nftables backend.
